q: aicoo, draft a PR description for adding dark mode toggle.
reply: 好的，凯哥。根据你之前的风格（PR descriptions 以 Risk section 结尾），以及 dark mode toggle 的最新情况（manual toggle 先 ship，auto-toggle 后续考虑），这是 draft：

**Title:** Add dark mode toggle (manual) — Phase 1

**Description:**
- Implement manual dark mode toggle in user settings
- Beta tested with 92% satisfaction, 82% prefer toggle over system default
- Phase 1: manual toggle only. Auto-toggle based on system preference tabled for Phase 2
- Design from Yuki, dev handoff to Ravi complete, targeting Nov 30 delivery
- No conflict with Dec 1 pricing launch

**Risk:**
- Manual toggle only may disappoint users expecting auto-switch. Mitigation: communicate Phase 2 timeline in release notes and in-app banner. Dev capacity re-evaluated after pricing launch.
- If Phase 2 slips, potential user complaints. Monitoring feedback post-launch.
要调整吗？比如加上具体的 Jira ticket number 或 reviewer 名字？
